summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by SLM Student Loan Trust 2004-5, reporting that its administrator furnished a preliminary remarketing memorandum for the Class A-6 Reset Rate Notes to qualified institutional buyers. The filing includes pool information tables as of May 31, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed. The trust is an asset-backed securitization vehicle, and the remarketing is an ordinary course capital markets activity. There are no deal terms, premium, or board recommendations. This filing is not a special situation.
